problems.reason: Both sentences state that Luperosuchus was one of the largest carnivores and one of the few large animals in the Chañares Formation.
Both sentences describe a tall, mediolaterally compressed crest on the front of the snout.
Sentence 8 gives a minimum age of 236.1 ± 0.6 Ma (≈235.5–236.7 Ma), while sentence 10 places the animal between 241.464 and 237 Ma, which conflicts with the earlier range.
Sentence 11 discusses the braided river environment and volcanic deposits, which is about the geological setting rather than the animal itself.
